description: Vue 3 form library. Build forms with headless components (HeadlessForm, HeadlessField), field components (Enforma, EnformaField) or a schema object. Validation through @encolajs/validator, Zod, Yup or Valibot. UI presets for PrimeVue, Vuetify, Quasar, Reka UI and Nuxt UI. Repeatable fields and tables, sections, tabs, collapsibles, dynamic props, i18n.
rules: Import from '@encolajs/enforma', '@encolajs/enforma/presets/<kit>' and '@encolajs/enforma/validators/<encola|zod|yup|valibot>'. Never import from '@/...' paths: that alias exists only inside Enforma's own source.
Register the plugin with app.use(EnformaPlugin), then call the preset for the UI kit: usePrimeVuePreset(), useVuetifyPreset(), useQuasarPreset(), useRekauiPreset() or useNuxtUIPreset().

Give a form its validation through the validator prop of <Enforma> or <HeadlessForm>, built with createEncolaValidator, createZodValidator, createYupValidator or createValibotValidator. The rules prop is deprecated.
A schema is a flat object keyed by field path ('name', 'address.city'). Each entry has a type: 'field' (the default), 'repeatable', 'repeatable_table', 'section' or 'content'.
In a schema, a repeatable lists its fields in 'subfields', and an entry joins a section through its 'section' key.
A schema section shows its title only when it also has a titleComponent, for example titleComponent: 'h3'.
The 'rules' and 'messages' keys inside a schema work only with @encolajs/validator. With Zod, Yup or Valibot, build the validator separately and pass it to the form.
Validation rules for the items of a repeatable use a '*' wildcard path, for example 'addresses.*.street': 'required'.
